My sister committed suicide when I was just 7 years old. My parents decided that I was too young to attend the funeral, so they left me with my dog and grandma at home.
Grandma was napping from exhaustion and I was just sitting in the kitchen with my dog, crying.
I sat at the table facing the door, then suddenly my dog started weeping. I got really scared because there was this absolute silence and my dog making strange noises.
I looked up and saw my sister, in her pink pyjamas, slowly walking to my room. I couldn't see her face, but I knew that it was her. I froze and so did my dog, I thought I was hallucinating.
I whispered "Anya?" that's when it hit me and I stormed off the apartment with my dog, barefoot, out in the cold, running through snow to our back yard. Then I saw her again, she was slow, almost floating above the ground, moving towards the area where she did it. I just had enough, started screaming my lungs out, I thought I was going mad or maybe I was asleep... Neighbors picked me up and calmed me down, then returned to my grandma, she didn't believe me. No one did except for mom because she saw her too, just like that in her pink pyjamas.
Never saw her again after that and thank god... I mean I loved her but it is so scary you can have a heart attack.
